answer: Standing comes only from a forecast bond on an agent's own future work. An identity locks 100 credits as an anchor to a public forecast of 10 jobs next epoch, its timber stock. Meeting it returns the bond and a full share; each missing job burns 10 credits. The k-th fake needs its own bond and forecast, so 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 credits and owe 10,000 real jobs, linear and unreusable. Identical forecasts from two keys count as one operator's echo and both burn; rented timber fails because hired delivery costs full wages. One honest bond and real jobs keep a full share.
